# Conformance

<!-- Generated by scripts/conformance.py; edit conformance.json. -->

Milestones 0–4, the initial Milestone 5 product slice and independent geometry Milestones 6–10; no complete ISO edition or AP conformance claim.

Implemented means the named behavior has regression evidence, not that the full
standard or future semantic layer has been certified. No AP242 support is claimed.

| Feature | Status | Test evidence | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| streaming lexer | implemented | first_event_does_not_read_the_whole_file | BufRead; no full input buffering |
| simple/complex records | implemented | complex_instances_and_user_defined_names | schema hierarchy and component order validation deferred |
| generic parameter families | implemented | all_value_categories | typed argument count enforced; schema type compatibility deferred |
| Unicode and legacy pages | implemented | strings_and_page_reset | X2 scalar groups, not UTF-16 surrogate-pair compatibility |
| exact binary bit length | implemented | all_single_nibble_binary_encodings | zero physical leading padding required |
| numeric bounds | implemented | numeric_boundaries_and_underflow | i64/u64/f64 representation limits |
| headers and DATA sections | implemented | required_header_order_and_shape | header structure checked; implementation-level/schema-population semantics deferred |
| reader chunks and source spans | implemented | every_reader_chunk_size_has_identical_result | byte offsets; spans always retained |
| resource budgets | implemented | every_resource_budget_is_enforced | finite logical budgets; not an exact RSS cap |
| generic storage / duplicate IDs | implemented | duplicate_ids_never_overwrite_even_across_sections_or_namespaces | dense records, sparse ordered index |
| reference collection | implemented | unresolved_uses_retain_owner_and_exact_parameter_span | existence only; schema reference compatibility deferred |
| anchors and external declarations | syntax only | anchor_parameters_differ_from_entity_parameters | URI lexical checks; no fetching or anchor dereferencing |
| signature sections | syntax only | external_references_and_signatures_are_not_trusted | payload retained with warning; no cryptographic/CMS validation |
| determinism and regression corpus | implemented | corpus_regression_and_determinism | synthetic fixtures; external compatibility results in VALIDATION.md |
| fuzz smoke | implemented | fuzz_corpus_smoke | bounded deterministic mutations; industrial fuzzing not claimed |
| legacy scopes | unsupported | parser_and_lexer_fuse_after_failure | explicit TS1301 failure |
| archives / BOM / tolerant recovery | unsupported | — | clear-text input only; strict first-error behavior |
| EXPRESS lexer and source-located AST | implemented | express_ast_covers_declarations_and_retains_expressions | declaration subset; expression grammar is opaque |
| EXPRESS imports and schema IR | implemented | express_import_resolution_and_reexports | explicitly supplied sources; basic structural checks only |
| EXPRESS declaration and graph validation | implemented | express_semantic_checks_and_graph_cycles | no full expression/type/cardinality semantics or AP claim |
| EXPRESS inverse target lookup | implemented | express_inverse_targets_are_checked | forward type compatibility/cardinality explicitly unsupported |
| EXPRESS expressions and algorithms | syntax preservation only | express_opaque_semantics_are_never_silent | verbatim source with unsupported diagnostics; bodies not semantically validated |
| EXPRESS budgets and malformed input | implemented | express_resource_limits_cover_parsing_and_resolution | logical budgets; hard nesting ceiling 128; no recovery |
| EXPRESS expansion protection | implemented | express_expansion_budgets_are_enforced_before_copying | work budgets; not an exact RSS cap |
| EXPRESS fuzz smoke | implemented | express_fuzz_smoke | bounded deterministic mutations; industrial hardening not claimed |
| Deterministic Rust bindings and static reflection | implemented | generated_bindings_compile_and_reflect_deterministically | unchecked owned records and typed references; supplied declaration subset; opaque constraints retained |
| Code generation budgets | implemented | generation_limits_and_invalid_compilation | bounded output/work; hard domain depth 128; logical limits, not RSS or rustc resource limits |
| Code generation fuzz smoke | implemented | codegen_fuzz_smoke | bounded deterministic mutations; compiler invocation covered separately by consumer test |
| Schema-aware physical instance decoding/validation | structural subset implemented | schema_decode_complex_and_diamond_memberships | internal/external mappings, SELECT, bounds/widths/uniqueness and local references; rules, algorithms, general expressions and AP semantics unsupported |
| AP242 / AP203 / AP214 schema conformance | not implemented | — | names and raw values can be retained without understanding them |
| STEP geometry / topology / meshes | not implemented | — | independent analytic/NURBS curves and surfaces available; no STEP geometry adapter, topology or tessellation |
| public C ABI | physical documents implemented | c_abi_document_and_diagnostic_contract | ABI 1 shared library; buffer parsing, inspection and reference reports; schema/geometry/mesh APIs pending |
| public C++ wrapper / CMake package | physical documents implemented | tests/capi/consumer.cpp | C++17 RAII and typed results; relocated shared package via TessSTEP::TessSTEP; mesh views and static linkage pending |
| Generated schema validator and corpus stage | implemented | generated_metadata_decodes_physical_instances | explicit supplied schemas; structural JSON protocol; no bundled AP schema or automatic population selection |
| Schema decoder fuzz smoke | implemented | schema_decoder_fuzz_smoke | bounded mutations with generated metadata; extended instrumented fuzzing remains unobserved |
| Independent product/representation/assembly graphs | structural subset implemented | independent_product_graph_preserves_reuse_and_rejects_cycles | typed identities and immutable validated graph; no expanded instance tree or evaluated placements |
| Schema-decoded product adapters | structural subset implemented | product_adapter_follows_definitions_representations_and_occurrences | supplied metadata; explicit role subset and direct item/shape membership; no complete AP schema |
| SI and conversion-based unit scales | subset implemented | product_adapter_unit_failures_are_explicit_and_located | 3D contexts with length/plane-angle/solid-angle units; offsets, other dimensions and uncertainties unsupported |
| Mapped representation reuse and placement descriptions | structural subset implemented | product_adapter_complex_membership_and_mapping_reuse | ordered item pairs and map links preserved; matrices, axis values/defaults and indirect contexts not evaluated |
| Product adapter mutation smoke | implemented | product_adapter_fuzz_smoke | 1,500 bounded deterministic mutations; no extended instrumented fuzz result claimed |
| Independent typed coordinates, units and tolerances | implemented | math_coordinates_units_and_tolerances_are_explicit | finite f64 values; scalar coordinate units follow space convention; no complete dimensional algebra or exact predicates |
| Typed affine maps, inversion and normals | implemented | math_affine_composition_inversion_and_normal_contract | explicit matrices/frames; finite and pivot checks; no certified error/condition bounds or STEP placement adapter |
| Extreme-scale normalization and explicit frames | implemented | math_normalization_handles_extreme_scales_and_near_angles | floating-point accuracy; near-parallel frame rejection uses explicit numerical tolerance |
| Math arbitrary-float smoke | implemented | math_arbitrary_float_fuzz_smoke | 10,870 deterministic inputs; extended instrumented numerical fuzzing not observed |
| Independent 2D/3D analytic lines and conics | implemented | analytic_curves_have_known_positions_derivatives_and_domains | positions and two derivatives; floating-point evaluation; no STEP adapter, projection or intersection; NURBS tracked separately |
| Oriented analytic parameter spans | implemented | analytic_spans_keep_orientation_seams_and_chain_rule | unwrapped explicit parameter endpoints; no STEP trim selection, topological edges or UV trimming |
| Analytic curve numeric checks and smoke | implemented | analytic_curve_arbitrary_float_smoke | 10,774 deterministic inputs; no exact predicate, certified error bounds or extended instrumented fuzz claim |
| Independent analytic surface jets and singular normals | implemented | analytic_surfaces_known_values_and_singularities | plane/cylinder/cone/sphere/ring torus; explicit frame/domain conventions; no STEP surface adapter |
| Bounded positive-weight NURBS curves | implemented | nurbs_curve_rational_circle_and_derivatives | degrees 1–16; expanded knots, two derivatives, one-sided breaks; no zero/negative weights or automatic periodic wrapping |
| Homogeneous curve knot insertion | implemented | nurbs_knot_insertion_preserves_rational_geometry_and_derivatives | one strictly interior insertion at a time; no removal, elevation or certified error bound |
| Tensor-product NURBS surface jets | implemented | nurbs_surface_known_rational_partials_and_tensor_order | positive weights, bounded rectangular net; mixed/second derivatives; no STEP adaptation or trimming |
| Surface knot insertion with shared weight scale | implemented | nurbs_surface_refinement_preserves_global_weights | one interior insertion in either axis; bounded immutable replacement |
| Bounded spline and surface smoke | implemented | surface_bounded_arbitrary_float_smoke | two 5,641-case stable harnesses; no extended instrumented numerical-hardening claim |

The JSON manifest tracks physical syntax, the EXPRESS frontend and generated bindings.
Structural schema decoding and product graph adaptation are separate checked stages.
Independent analytic/NURBS curves and surfaces are tested separately from STEP geometry adaptation.
Full AP conformance, STEP geometry adaptation and tessellation remain future work.

See [PART21.md](PART21.md), [ERROR_MODEL.md](ERROR_MODEL.md) and
[VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md) for exact behavior and actual verification results.
